description: A receipt or acknowledgement from a portal (GSTN ARN, RBI CIMS, MCA SRN, PFRDA e-filing…) → what was filed, for which period, by whom, and the reference to keep as evidence.
instructions: The document acknowledges that a return, form or report was received or filed. Extract the acknowledgement reference exactly as printed (ARN, SRN, acknowledgement number, ticket). Identify the return or form type, the period it covers, the filing entity and its registration id (GSTIN, PAN, CIN, licence number), the filing date and the status word used by the portal. Amounts only if printed.

fields.name: portal
fields.description: Portal or authority that issued the acknowledgement

fields.name: period
fields.description: Period covered, as printed (e.g. 08/2026, Q1 FY2026-27)

fields.name: status
fields.description: Status word as printed (FILED, RECEIVED, ACCEPTED…)
